svg_mode.label: Use
svg_mode.help: Fill uses the filled areas of the drawing. Line uses only its outlines, at the width they have in the file.

walls_segment.label: Side walls part
walls_segment.help: The side walls of the letters get their own part, so they can have another colour. Empty: the walls share the surface part.

segment.label: Surface part
segment.help: The top of raised letters, the floor of engraved ones, or the coloured area when flat.

shape.label: Drawing
shape.help: A drawing kept in the project. Import an SVG file to make one.

walls_segment.label: Side walls part
walls_segment.help: The side walls of the drawing get their own part, so they can have another colour. Empty: the walls share the surface part.

segment.label: Surface part
segment.help: The top of a raised drawing, the floor of an engraved one, or the coloured area when flat.

size.label: Size
size.help: How tall the drawing is on the model.

triangles.label: Triangles
triangles.help: How many triangles the low-poly model gets. Fewer triangles means bigger facets.

sharpness.label: Sharpness
sharpness.help: Edges sharper than this angle stay crisp creases. A lower angle keeps more edges, so the model looks more faceted.

crystallise.label: Crystallise
crystallise.help: Pulls corners towards the planes of the original surface, so facets get flatter and corners cleaner. 0 switches it off.

keep_borders.label: Keep open borders
keep_borders.help: Keeps the outline where the model has open edges. Only matters for models that are not closed.

triangles_mode.label: Amount
triangles_mode.help: Automatic finds how few triangles the shape needs. A fixed number lets you choose.

detail.label: Detail
detail.help: How faithful the result stays to the original. Low is bold and artistic, high stays close to the original.

facet_size.label: Facet size
facet_size.help: About how long the edges of the facets are: the surface is remeshed into flat triangles of about this size, like a hand-made low-poly mug.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.help: How far each corner of a facet may move in or out, at random. 0 gives an even low-poly surface.

shift.label: Sideways
shift.help: How far each corner may also move sideways, as a share of the facet size.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: Another number gives other facets; the same number gives the same ones.

inside.label: Inside
inside.help: For a vase or a mug. Follow: the inside of the wall moves with the outside, so the wall keeps its thickness. Smooth: the inside stays as it was. A solid model has no inside and stays solid.

wall.label: Least wall
wall.help: A corner that moves in never leaves less than this to the other side of a wall.

plain_bottom.label: Plain bottom
plain_bottom.help: Keep the lowest part of the model plain, this many mm high (0: none): it is remeshed like the rest, but its corners do not move, and it ends in a straight horizontal edge.

plain_top.label: Plain top
plain_top.help: Keep the highest part of the model plain, this many mm high (0: none): it is remeshed like the rest, but its corners do not move, and it ends in a straight horizontal edge.

facet_colours.label: Colours
facet_colours.help: One colour; two alternating colours (neighbouring facets differ where they can); or random colours from a palette. Each colour is its own segment, ready for a multicolour print. One colour keeps the colours the model already had.

palette_size.label: Palette
palette_size.help: How many colours the random facets choose from.

colour_1.label: Colour 1
colour_1.help: The first facet colour (also the colour of a model without colours).

style.label: Style
style.help: Reduce: few large facets that follow the shape. Even facets: a mosaic of equal-sized triangles with a random in-and-out jitter, like a hand-made low-poly mug.

region.label: Area shape
region.help: The pattern fills a rectangle or a circle around the spot you place it on.

margin.label: Margin
margin.help: Space between the pattern and the edge of the area.

cells.label: Cells
cells.help: About how many cells the pattern has. More cells make smaller, finer cells.

seed.label: Pattern number
seed.help: Each number gives another pattern. The same number always gives the same pattern.

irregularity.label: Irregularity
irregularity.help: 0 gives even, honeycomb-like cells. 1 gives wild, uneven cells.

line_width.label: Line width
line_width.help: Width of the lines between the cells.

fill.label: Cells instead of lines
fill.help: Makes the cells themselves the shape, with a gap of one line width between them.

rounding.label: Rounded corners
rounding.help: Rounds the corners of the cells. 0 keeps them sharp.

segment.label: Surface part
segment.help: The top of raised lines, the floor of engraved ones, or the coloured area when flat.

walls_segment.label: Side walls part
walls_segment.help: The side walls get their own part, so they can have another colour. Empty: the walls share the surface part.

weld.label: Join points closer than
weld.help: Points closer together than this become one point. 0 switches it off.

non_manifold.label: Edges with too many faces
non_manifold.help: An edge belongs to exactly two triangles. Where more meet, the extra triangles are split off or removed.

fix_normals.label: Face the surface outwards
fix_normals.help: Turns triangles that face the wrong way round, so the model is a solid.

min_island.label: Remove small loose pieces
min_island.help: Pieces smaller than this share of the largest piece go. Pieces of fewer than four triangles always go. 0 keeps everything.

max_hole.label: Close holes up to
max_hole.help: The number of edges around the hole. Bigger holes stay open. 0 closes none.

angle.label: Twist
angle.help: How far the top turns compared with the bottom. A negative angle turns the other way.

easing.label: Progression
easing.help: Linear turns evenly. Smooth starts and ends gently.

axis.label: Axis
axis.help: The direction the model is twisted along. Z is up.

from.label: Start
from.help: Where the twist starts, as a share of the height. Below it the model stays as it is.

to.label: End
to.help: Where the twist ends. Above it the model is turned as a whole.

detail.label: Smoothness
detail.help: How finely the surface is cut to follow the twist. Finer is smoother but heavier.

max_triangles.label: Largest result
max_triangles.help: The step stops if the result would have more triangles than this.

scale_end.label: Size at the end
scale_end.help: The size of the top compared with the bottom. 0.5 makes it half as wide.

uniform.label: Direction
uniform.help: Which sides get smaller. The first and second of the two directions that are not the axis.

easing.label: Progression
easing.help: Linear changes the size evenly. Smooth starts and ends gently.

axis.label: Axis
axis.help: The direction the model is tapered along. Z is up.

from.label: Start
from.help: Where the taper starts, as a share of the height.

to.label: End
to.help: Where the taper ends. Above it the model keeps its end size.

detail.label: Smoothness
detail.help: How finely the surface is cut to follow the taper. Finer is smoother but heavier.

max_triangles.label: Largest result
max_triangles.help: The step stops if the result would have more triangles than this.

part.label: Part
part.help: Choose a body or a coloured region of the surface.

close_hole.label: The opening
close_hole.help: Removing a region of the surface leaves an opening. Close it with a cap, or leave it for a later step.

remove_unused.label: Remove unused points
remove_unused.help: Points that no triangle uses any more are dropped.

part.label: Part
part.help: Choose a body or a coloured region of the surface.

close_hole.label: The opening
close_hole.help: Removing a region of the surface leaves an opening. Close it with a cap, or leave it for a later step.

remove_unused.label: Remove unused points
remove_unused.help: Points that no triangle uses any more are dropped.

beam_rounding.label: Roundness of the struts
beam_rounding.help: How round the struts are: 0 keeps square edges, 1 makes them round.

thickness.label: Wall thickness
thickness.help: How deep the wall is, measured inward from the outside of the model.

rib_width.label: Strut width
rib_width.help: The width of the struts between the openings.

smooth.label: Rounded joints
smooth.help: Rounds the joints between the struts. 0 keeps them sharp.

cells.label: Openings
cells.help: About how many openings the shell has. More openings are smaller.

seed.label: Pattern number
seed.help: Each number gives another pattern. The same number always gives the same pattern.

irregularity.label: Irregularity
irregularity.help: 0 gives even, honeycomb-like openings. 1 gives wild, uneven ones.

opening.label: Opening
opening.help: A round opening along the vertical (Z) axis through the top and/or the bottom.

detail.label: Detail
detail.help: Automatic uses a grid a third of the thinnest strut or wall. Coarse is faster, fine is smoother.

max_triangles.label: Triangle limit
max_triangles.help: If the shell has more triangles than this, it is reduced.

amplitude.label: Depth
amplitude.help: How far the surface moves. A negative number cuts into it.

scale.label: Tile size
scale.help: The size of one repeat of the pattern.

image.label: Picture
image.help: A PNG or JPEG. Light is high, dark is low.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: Another number gives another random pattern.

roughness.label: Roughness
roughness.help: How much the fine detail shows.

octaves.label: Layers
octaves.help: How many layers of detail the noise has.

fill.label: Coverage
fill.help: How much of each cell the raised part takes.

offset.label: Zero level
offset.help: 0 raises from the surface, 1 cuts into it, 0.5 does both.

mapping.label: Wrapping
mapping.help: How the pattern is laid on the model.

blend.label: Sharpness of the joins
blend.help: How sharply the sides of the wrapping meet. Higher is sharper.

region.label: Only on
region.help: Texture only this part. Empty: the whole model.

skip_bottom.label: Leave the bottom smooth
skip_bottom.help: Faces that look down (within 20 degrees of flat) get no texture, so the model sits flat on the bed.

edge_falloff.label: Fade near edges
edge_falloff.help: The texture fades out in a straight ramp this far from a sharp edge and from the border of the part, so edges stay crisp. 0 runs the pattern right up to the edge.

segment.label: Colour part
segment.help: Give the textured triangles this colour part, for multicolour printing.

detail.label: Detail
detail.help: How finely the surface is cut to follow the pattern. Finer is sharper but heavier.

smooth_normals.label: Smooth directions
smooth_normals.help: Move the surface along smoothed directions, so sharp edges do not tear.

max_triangles.label: Largest result
max_triangles.help: The step stops if the result would have more triangles than this.

strength.label: Strength
strength.help: How much each round smooths. 0 changes nothing.

iterations.label: Rounds
iterations.help: How many rounds. More rounds smooth wider bumps.

keep_edges.label: Keep edges sharper than
keep_edges.help: Edges where the surface turns by more than this angle stay crisp (they are smoothed along their length only). 180 smooths everything.

part.label: Part
part.help: Smooth only this part. Leave it empty to smooth the whole model.

falloff.label: Fade-in
falloff.help: How far from the edge of the part the smoothing fades in.

keep_volume.label: Keep the size
keep_volume.help: On: the model does not shrink (Taubin smoothing). Off: plain smoothing, which shrinks the model a little with every round.

keep_borders.label: Keep open borders
keep_borders.help: Keep the border of an open mesh where it is.

max_move.label: Largest move
max_move.help: The most a point may move. 0 means no limit.

thickness.label: Wall thickness
thickness.help: How deep the wall is, measured inward from the outside of the model.

smooth.label: Smooth inside
smooth.help: How much the inside is smoothed. 0 keeps what the grid gives.

opening.label: Opening
opening.help: A round opening along the vertical (Z) axis through the top and/or the bottom, to drain, vent or fit something in. With an opening the outside of the model is made again.

detail.label: Detail
detail.help: Automatic uses a grid a third of the wall. Coarse is faster, fine is smoother.

max_triangles.label: Triangle limit
max_triangles.help: If the result has more triangles than this, it is reduced (only with an opening; otherwise the outside is never reduced).

cavity_segment.label: Inside part
cavity_segment.help: The name of the part given to the inside surface. Empty gives it no part of its own.

angle.label: Bend
angle.help: How far the model is bent over the range. A negative angle bends it the other way.

axis.label: Along
axis.help: The direction the model is long in: the bend runs along it. Z is up.

bend_axis.label: Folds towards
bend_axis.help: The direction the model folds towards. It must be a different axis from the one above.

from.label: Start
from.help: Where the bend starts, as a share of the length. Below it the model stays as it is.

to.label: End
to.help: Where the bend ends. Beyond it the model is carried on straight.

detail.label: Smoothness
detail.help: How finely the surface is cut to follow the bend. Finer is smoother but heavier.

max_triangles.label: Largest result
max_triangles.help: The step stops if the result would have more triangles than this.

amplitude.label: Height
amplitude.help: How far the surface moves up and down.

wavelength.label: Wavelength
wavelength.help: The distance from one crest to the next.

phase.label: Start of the wave
phase.help: Where in the wave the range starts.

axis.label: Travels along
axis.help: The direction the wave travels along.

direction.label: Moves
direction.help: The direction the surface moves in. "Along the surface" follows the shape.

falloff.label: Fade at the ends
falloff.help: The length over which the wave fades in and out at the ends of the range. 0 starts at full height.

from.label: Start
from.help: Where along the length the wave starts, as a share of the length.

detail.label: Smoothness
detail.help: How finely the surface is cut to follow the wave. Finer is smoother but heavier.

max_triangles.label: Largest result
max_triangles.help: The step stops if the result would have more triangles than this.

amplitude.label: Height
amplitude.help: How far the surface moves up and down.

wavelength.label: Ring distance
wavelength.help: The distance from one ring to the next.

decay.label: Fade away
decay.help: How fast the rings fade away from the centre. 0 keeps them the same everywhere.

radius.label: Reach
radius.help: The rings stop at this distance from the centre. 0 means no limit.

phase.label: Start of the wave
phase.help: Where in the wave the centre starts. 90 starts with a smooth crest in the middle; 0 starts with a point.

axis.label: Moves along
axis.help: The direction the surface moves in. The rings lie in the other two directions.

detail.label: Smoothness
detail.help: How finely the surface is cut to follow the rings. Finer is smoother but heavier.

max_triangles.label: Largest result
max_triangles.help: The step stops if the result would have more triangles than this.

process.label: Printer type
process.help: The kind of printer: it sets the smallest wall, detail and gap that print well.

nozzle.label: Nozzle
nozzle.help: The width of the line the nozzle lays down.

layer_height.label: Layer height
layer_height.help: Details thinner than four layers do not come out.

bed.label: Build volume
bed.help: The build volume. Use 0 on an axis to leave it out.

min_wall.label: Thinnest wall
min_wall.help: The thinnest wall that prints. 0 chooses it from the printer (twice the nozzle; 0.6 mm for resin).

min_feature.label: Thinnest post or pin
min_feature.help: The thinnest post, pin or spike. 0 chooses it from the printer.

min_gap.label: Narrowest gap
min_gap.help: The narrowest gap that stays open. 0 chooses it from the printer.

overhang_angle.label: Overhang angle
overhang_angle.help: Faces that lean over more than this need support.

bridge_length.label: Longest bridge
bridge_length.help: The longest flat roof that prints without support.

min_overhang_area.label: Smallest overhang to support
min_overhang_area.help: A sloped overhang smaller than this is left out of the advice to add support.

placement.label: Place
placement.help: Click on the model where the hole goes.

diameter.label: Size
diameter.help: Round: the diameter. Slot and square: the width.

length.label: Length
length.help: How long the slot or the square is.

depth.label: Depth
depth.help: How deep the hole goes from the place you chose. 0 cuts all the way through.

countersink.label: Screw head
countersink.help: A wider opening at the top, for a screw head: a cone (countersink) or a cylinder (counterbore).

countersink_diameter.label: Opening width
countersink_diameter.help: The width of the wider opening at the surface.

countersink_depth.label: Depth of the wider part
countersink_depth.help: How deep the wider part goes. A countersink is 90 degrees and takes the depth it needs.

corner_radius.label: Rounded corners
corner_radius.help: How round the corners of the square are.

rotation.label: Turn
rotation.help: Turns the slot or the square about its axis, on top of the direction of the place.

axis.label: Direction of the hole
axis.help: Which way the hole goes. Surface: straight into the surface at the place. X, Y or Z: along that axis, into the model.

min_wall.label: Thinnest wall
min_wall.help: The thinnest wall that may stay under the bottom of a blind hole. A thinner one gives a warning.

part.label: Part to cut
part.help: Cut only through this part of the surface. Empty: the whole model.

keep_proportions.label: Keep proportions
keep_proportions.help: On: the other directions follow. Off: only the chosen direction changes (a stretch).

percent_x.label: Size along X
percent_x.help: How large the model is along X, in percent.

percent_y.label: Size along Y
percent_y.help: How large the model is along Y, in percent.

percent_z.label: Size along Z
percent_z.help: How large the model is along Z, in percent.

mode.label: Method
mode.help: Either remove every triangle that does not change the shape by more than the quality asks, or reduce to a number of triangles you choose.

tolerance.label: Quality
tolerance.help: How far the surface may move. A smaller number keeps more triangles and more detail.

target_triangles.label: Target triangles
target_triangles.help: The number of triangles to reduce to.

max_error.label: Largest move
max_error.help: 0 means no limit on how far the surface may move.

name.label: Store as
name.help: Keeps the result of the steps above under this name. Later steps can load it.

name.label: Stored item
name.help: Brings back a stored model or drawing as the one the next steps work on.

order.analyseLast: {{step}} only checks the model; it changes nothing. It looks at the model as it is at this point, so it works best as the last step.
order.blockedNote: The steps below it wait until this is solved. They keep their previous result.
order.decimateAfterText: This step comes after the text, so it smooths the letters: their borders are kept, but fine detail is lost. It works best above the text steps.
order.hint: Steps run from top to bottom. Each step works on the result of the step above it.
order.keepExactHint: Moves Size to the top. The text stays on the same spot of the part.
order.moved: “{{step}}” is now step {{n}}. The steps below it run again.
order.orientLast: Auto-orient only turns the model. Keep it last, so the steps before it work on the model as you see it.
order.partDropped: The part “{{part}}” was made by an earlier step, but a step in between removes it.
order.partMissing: No file or earlier step makes the part “{{part}}”.
order.rotateAfterText: This step comes after the text, so it turns the letters with the model. It works best above the text steps.
order.scaledBelow: Step {{n}} (Size) runs after this one and scales these letters: they end up {{size}} mm high.
order.scalesAbove: This step comes after {{count}} text steps, so it scales their letters too: “{{text}}” ends up {{size}} mm high instead of {{orig}} mm.
order.repairFirst: Repairing works best as the first step, so every other step starts from a sound model.
order.deformAfterText: This step bends the surface the text sits on, so the letters change shape with it. It works best above the text steps.
order.reduceBeforeDeform: Reducing triangles before a twist or taper gives the deform step a rougher surface to follow. It works best below it.
order.partsFirst: Deleting or keeping a part works best near the start, so the other steps only work on what stays.
order.textureBeforeText: A texture covers the surface the text sits on, so the letters would be roughened with it. It works best above the text steps.
order.reduceAfterTexture: Reducing triangles after a texture smooths it away. It works best above the texture step.
order.smoothAfterText: Smoothing after the text or a pattern rounds their edges. It works best above them.
order.smoothBeforeSurface: Smoothing evens out what the steps below it make (a shell, a texture, a twist). It works best below them.
order.hollowLast: Hollowing works on the outside the steps above it made. Text, a texture or a pattern added after it would touch the wall. It works best below them.
order.hollowBeforeShell: A Voronoi shell above this step is made from the whole solid, not from the hollow part. Put this step above it.
order.cheeseLast: The holes are cut into the surface the steps above it made. Text, a texture, a pattern or a twist added after this step would be cut by the holes or bend them. Move it below those steps.
order.cheeseBeforeSmooth: A Smooth surface step above this one cannot round the rims of the holes. Put this step above it.
order.holesLast: The hole is cut through the surface the steps above it made. Text, a texture, a pattern, holes or a twist added after this step would run into the hole or distort it. Move it below those steps.
order.holesBeforeSmooth: A Smooth surface step above this one would not round the rim of the hole. Put this step above it.
order.customerTyped: Customers see and are limited in the height before this scaling, so they would see {{orig}} mm for letters that print {{size}} mm high.

build.entryTitle: Want to make your own plugin?
build.entryHint: A short guide, an example and a prompt for your AI agent.
build.title: Build your own plugin
build.intro: A plugin is a small program that changes a model: it can put a pattern on the surface, bend or twist a shape, hollow it out or check it for printing problems. Anyone can write one, and it works in AtelierMesh like the built-in steps.
build.need1: A text editor, or a coding agent that writes the code for you.
build.need2: Node.js (no npm needed; Python 3 can pack too), to test and pack the plugin.
build.need3: An idea of what the plugin should do, in plain words.
build.step1: Describe what it does in a sentence or two.
build.step2: Start from the example plugin in the kit: copy its folder.
build.step3: Write the manifest (its name, settings and limits) and the run function (the code that changes the model).
build.step4: Test it: the example shows how to check a result and that a model is never broken.
build.step5: Pack it into one file and load it here with “Choose a plugin file”.
build.safe: A plugin from a file runs in a sandbox: it only gets the model it works on, and it has no network. A plugin that is not signed asks for your approval first. You can trust the key of a signer you know under “Trusted signers”.
build.copy: Copy a prompt for your AI agent
build.copied: Copied. Paste it into your coding agent and fill in the parts in {{double braces}}.
build.manual: Your browser would not copy it. Select the text below and copy it yourself.
build.kitHint: The kit has everything to build a plugin on your own computer: the guide, the source of the example, the packages and the packing tool. Nothing needs to be installed from npm except the usual tools.
build.exampleHint: The packed example is only for trying the loader: choose it with “Choose a plugin file”.
build.noNpmHint: No npm? Pick “Without npm”: the prompt then asks for plain JavaScript and uses tools that need only Node, only Python 3, or nothing but a text editor.

welcome.title: Welcome to AtelierMesh
welcome.lead: Put a name, a pattern or a texture on a 3D model, right in your browser.
welcome.open: Start from your own STL or 3MF file, or open one of the samples.
welcome.steps: Add steps: text, textures, patterns, twists and more. Each step works on the result of the one above it, and you see it live.
welcome.private: Everything runs in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
welcome.save: Save your work in this browser or as a file, and export a 3MF or STL for printing.

v0_3_0.svg: SVG on the surface: put your own SVG logo or drawing on a model. It is saved with your project, and keeps its real size.
v0_3_0.menu: A better Add a step menu: search, steps grouped by plugin, your recent steps, and a bottom sheet on a phone.
v0_3_0.store: Store and Load steps (under More) keep the result of some steps under a name and bring it back later.
